title: Molecular insights into PARP1 activation: structural dynamics of DNA, NAD+, and zinc‑mediated allosteric regulation.
authors: Munir, Areeba; Naseer, Noorulain; Koser, Taskeen; Khalid, Rana Rehan
one_liner_zh: 该文通过MD模拟与MMPBSA分析研究PARP1-DNA-NAD+-Zn复合物的变构激活机制，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作的结构动态研究，方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系，但对象非转录因子。
abstract: PARP1 serves as a crucial protein for preserving genomic stability, especially in BRCA1/2-mutant cancers that lack homologous recombination repair. In response to DNA breaks, PARP1 triggers an allosteric response that communicates to its catalytic domain, initiating the synthesis of poly (ADP-ribose) from NAD+. In this study, we used RMSF, hydrogen bond, hydrophobic, and MMPBSA analyses to construct an interface-specific map of PARP1 activation, revealing how DNA, Zn ions, and NAD+ act at each domain interface to drive activation. Our findings show that DNA initiates allosteric signaling, Zn ions and NAD+ strengthen activating interfaces and weaken inhibitory contacts. We found that PARP1 recognizes DNA damage through its ZF1, ZF3, and WGR domains with Zn ions at ZF1 stabilizing DNA binding. Allosteric contacts arose at the ZF1-ZF3 interface strengthened by DNA, ZF3-WGR interface reinforced by Zn ions, and ZF1-WGR interface stabilized by both DNA and Zn ions. This allosteric communication, alongside NAD+, induced a conformational shift in the HD domain enhancing WGR-HD and ZF3-HD interactions and destabilizing HD-ART. This movement, opened the catalytic pocket for NAD+ binding, promoting PARylation. Our study shows that full PARP1 activation requires the PARP1-DNA-Zn-NAD+ complex. These findings advance understanding of PARP1 and may aid development of targeted inhibitors for synthetic lethality-based cancer therapy.
abstract_zh: PARP1 是维持基因组稳定性的关键蛋白，尤其在缺乏同源重组修复的 BRCA1/2 突变癌症中。响应 DNA 断裂时，PARP1 触发变构反应，将信号传递至其催化结构域，启动从 NAD+ 合成聚（ADP-核糖）的过程。在本研究中，我们利用 RMSF、氢键、疏水性和 MMPBSA 分析构建了 PARP1 激活的界面特异性图谱，揭示了 DNA、Zn 离子和 NAD+ 如何在各结构域界面发挥作用以驱动激活。我们的发现表明，DNA 启动变构信号传导，Zn 离子和 NAD+ 增强激活界面并削弱抑制性接触。我们发现 PARP1 通过其 ZF1、ZF3 和 WGR 结构域识别 DNA 损伤，其中 ZF1 处的 Zn 离子稳定 DNA 结合。变构接触出现在 ZF1-ZF3 界面（由 DNA 增强）、ZF3-WGR 界面（由 Zn 离子强化）以及 ZF1-WGR 界面（由 DNA 和 Zn 离子共同稳定）。这种变构通讯与 NAD+ 协同作用，诱导 HD 结构域发生构象转变，增强 WGR-HD 和 ZF3-HD 相互作用，并 destabilizing HD-ART。这一运动打开了催化口袋以供 NAD+ 结合，促进 PARylation。我们的研究表明，完全激活 PARP1 需要 PARP1-DNA-Zn-NAD+ 复合物。这些发现推进了对 PARP1 的理解，并可能有助于开发基于合成致死性癌症疗法的靶向抑制剂。
